likely_cause: Distributor installed off by one tooth, stretched timing chain, or faulty cam/crank sensor.
Carbon buildup holding the EGR valve pintle open, or faulty EGR valve.
Worn TCC regulator valve bore in the 4L60E valve body, causing torque converter slip and harsh 1-2 shifts.
Faulty Torque Converter Clutch Pulse Width Modulation solenoid or wiring harness inside the 4L60E transmission pan.
Degraded or slow-responding upstream oxygen sensor, exhaust leak before the sensor, or wiring issue.
Defective EVAP purge solenoid stuck open, or cracked vacuum lines pulling fuel vapors into the intake manifold.
Faulty Transmission Fluid Pressure manual valve position switch assembly or debris in the 4L60E valve body.
